w: A special evening assembly of 2,000 tribals from the Dang district was held.

This evening, an assembly of 2,000 tribals from the district of Dang was held. Colorful, traditional tribal dances were performed by the local youths. The assembly was also attended by two royal members from the tribal community.

The assembly climaxed with Swamishri’s blessings : "... God has given us this human body not to just eat and drink. Even animals indulge and live like this. God, however, has endowed man with the power of discrimination so he knows what is worthy and worthless. Our holy scriptures, spiritual luminaries, and incarnations of God explain and make us aware of this truth.

"By killing animals for food, one can never seek to achieve progress in life. We should have the noble feelings of ‘To live and let others live’ - then only can we be called humans... After so much worldly progress there should also be progress within ourself. We have to rise and come out from the animal life..."
ph: Atmaswarup Swami presents a memento to the Ayatollah

w: During the evening assembly Swamishri said, "One may be intelligent and successfully perform worldly tasks but if one cannot realise the glory of God, inspire peace, and instead stokes conflict, then of what use is intelligence? "God does not make anyone miserable. He descends to make everyone happy. He has shown the path to happiness but if one does not follow it then what can He do? If you do not walk on the highway, and instead walk through the bushes, stony and thorny grounds, then whose fault is it?..."

A reporter from the daily, Times of India, posed a couple of questions to Swamishri: Q : Under your leadership the Swaminarayan Sanstha has progressed tremendously. According to you which are your three principal achievements? Swamishri : Akshardham, London Mandir and other small and large mandirs. From them everyone can attain the knowledge of God. It is also an achievement that the intelligentsia have come to understand (the glory of God). (Since the mandirs are an instrument for) The development of faith in God, that is also another achievement. (Through the mandirs) Many have become sadhus who spread dharma and inspire everyone on the path of righteousness. All these achievements are due to the glory of Bhagwan Swaminarayan and the blessings of Shastriji Maharaj and Yogiji Maharaj. Q2 : What are your plans for the next ten years? Swamishri : Our endeavors are towards awakening religious feelings in people, inspiring faith in God and promoting peace in society.
In the evening assembly a wonderful drama presentation by BAPS children conveyed the message of successful study and character. Finally Swamishri blessed the assembly.

In the evening, part one of the drama presentation on the life and work of Gunatitanand Swami, Jai Jai Gunatitanand, was made by 300 BAPS youths and children. The drama was written by Sadhu Brahmaprakashdas.
A boy from Nadiad came to Pramukh Swami Maharaj and said proudly, "Bapa! I have reached tenth grade. Please bless me." Swamishri blessed him and then said gently, "How is the TV going?"
Swamishri said, "If you want good results, put the TV aside, do puja of God and pray."
Swamishri gave the boy's own enthusiasm a new direction.

st.t: “Renewed Value to Me,” Expresses Guyana Minister of Foreign Affairs and International Cooperation Hugh Todd on Visiting Swaminarayan Akshardham
w: Guyana Minister of Foreign Affairs and International Cooperation Hon. Hugh Todd visits Swaminarayan Akshardham in New Delhi on 1 May 2022. Guyana Foreign Minister Hon. Hugh Todd traditionally welcomed by Gnanmunidas Swami. Guyana Foreign Minister Hon. Hugh Todd offers abhishek for world peace and prosperity. Guyana Foreign Minister Hon. Hugh Todd and Guyanese delegation at Swaminarayan Akshardham in New Delhi on 1 May 2022. Guyana Minister of Foreign Affairs and International Cooperation Hon. Hugh Todd visits Swaminarayan Akshardham in New Delhi on 1 May 2022.

Guyana Minister of Foreign Affairs and International Cooperation Honourable Hugh Hilton Todd visited Swaminarayan Akshardham in New Delhi while on an official visit to India. Minister Todd was greeted and traditionally welcomed by Gnanmunidas Swami on behalf of His Holiness Mahant Swami Maharaj.
The Guyana Foreign Minister along with the five-member Guyanese delegation offered respects at the Swaminarayan Akshardham Mandir and performed abhishek for world peace and prosperity.

After viewing Gajendra Peeth of carved stone elephants depicting messages of peace, spirituality, family values and social harmony, the delegation experienced the educational exhibitions: Sahajanand Darshan (Hall of Values) – shows depicting the ideals of nonviolence, honesty, harmony, faith and others; Neelkanth Darshan – a film on the epic journey of Neelkanth Varni throughout India; and Sanskruti Vihar – a cultural boat ride highlighting 10,000 years of Indian history, heritage and discoveries.
Mementos commemorating Swaminarayan Akshardham and the birth centenary celebrations of Pramukh Swami Maharaj were specially presented to Minister Todd and the delegation.

“Today was a blessed day. The tour has brought renewed value to me personally. I feel uplifted and truly blessed,” wrote Guyana Foreign Minister Todd, while expressing his gratitude and personal sentiments.
